producer_report.summary: Added a local in-flight table. state.rs gets InFlightStage, InFlightEntry and InFlightTable (read, set, remove). The file is in-flight.json in the state root, written through a temp file and rename, and StateDir::in_flight_table returns it. drain.rs gets two defaulted Steps methods, in_flight_table and worktree, which RealSteps implements. The drain records a row in the producer stage before the run and in the landing stage before landing. It removes the row when the run fails or the landing finishes. At start it reports leftover rows as a ui line and a note. A missing file counts as empty. A corrupt file becomes a note, and the drain carries on. Nothing acts on leftover rows. New tests cover state.rs and drain.rs. fmt, clippy and the policy scan are clean, and the existing drain tests pass untouched.

open_issues: Worktree recorded for RealSteps is StateDir::kept_work_dir(job); I did not confirm it is where the live producer work tree sits during a run.
Leftover rows are reported (ui line and Report note) but not acted on, and they stay in the file, so they repeat on every drain until a later job clears them.
learnings: Steps had no state-directory access, so I added two defaulted trait methods (in_flight_table, worktree); RealSteps implements them from athena.state.
The drain cannot see inside Steps::run, so the checks stage (InFlightStage::Checks) exists in the enum but the drain itself writes only producer and landing.
